insideD.name: V7_HAWAII_CLEANROOM_INSIDE_D_PREFERRED_STUDY_2026_08_15
insideD.source: Inside A 1247:2 through bounded C and D comparisons
insideD.visibleProblem: Inside A left page concentrated photography/profile density in the upper half while the lower common-point payoff was isolated near the footer, leaving the Q&A and lower page feeling disconnected and under-edited.
insideD.rootCauseHypothesis: The lower-page weakness came from editorial hierarchy and vertical rhythm, not from missing decoration. A stronger native-type payoff could create a second focal anchor without adding weak or repeated imagery.
boundedChanges: moved 3 QUESTIONS and Q1/Q2/Q3 native text upward into a tighter editorial field
moved OUR COMMON POINT into the active reading path
increased only the native COMMON payoff typography from 23px to 34px and widened it to 650px
narrowed Q1 answer text box from 500px to 450px after absolute-bound collision QA, with characters/font-size/line count preserved
preserved all photography, masks, image hashes, right page geometry, factual wording and semantic native text
insideD.visualDecision: preferred over Inside A and intermediate C because the left page now has a deliberate second typographic focal point and a more continuous profile -> Q&A -> shared-travel reading path, without adding card/UI geometry or repeated imagery
